hero_subhead: Every Impact Product™ supports a partner nonprofit — tracked openly.

how_steps.title: A product is designated
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab™ marks a specific product as an Impact Product and designates a share of each sale for a partner nonprofit.

how_steps.title: The allocation is recorded
how_steps.description: Each sale's share is logged to the partner's ledger.

how_steps.title: Totals are public
how_steps.description: Running totals per partner below — no customer details.

how_steps.title: Funds are remitted
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab™ reconciles and sends the allocated amount to each partner directly, on a regular cadence.

how_notice: Full transparency: Stripe doesn't split funds automatically. Unless a partner has its own Stripe Connect account, The Co.LLab™ tracks the nonprofit share and sends it directly. The ledger below shows what's allocated and what's been sent.
